products.name: Sunset Lamp Projector
products.tagline: Cast a warm sunset glow across any wall — 16 colors, USB-powered, adjustable angle.
benefits: Projects a soft sunset/rainbow gradient onto walls and ceilings for photos and ambiance.
16 colors with a rotating head — angle it where you want the light to land.
USB-powered: plug into any phone charger, laptop, or power bank. No batteries.
Ships in 1-2 business days, delivery 7-12 days, 30-day returns.
products.description: A compact projection lamp that casts a warm, sunset-style gradient of light across a wall or ceiling — popular for room ambiance, photo and video backdrops, and streaming setups. The head rotates so you can aim the glow, and it runs off any standard USB port (charger, laptop, or power bank). 16 color settings. This is a décor light; it is not a primary room light or a medical or therapeutic device.
products.shipping: Ships in 1-2 business days. Delivery 7-12 days. 30-day returns.
